triage.root_cause: save() in storage.py does not call fsync() on file before rename or on directory after rename, leaving data vulnerable to loss on power failure
risk_points: src/flywheel/storage.py:116-117 - No fsync before closing file
src/flywheel/storage.py:120 - No dir fd sync after atomic rename
verification_targets: Mock test for file fsync before rename
Mock test for directory fsync after rename

fix.approach: Added os.fsync(file_fd) before closing temp file and os.fsync(dir_fd) after os.replace() to ensure durability on POSIX systems
